digest.component_or_area: op-cert service key provisioning and signing
propositions: Per-job boto3/SSM/region key lookup couples app config to one secret store and creates concurrency/cleanup hazards; move key acquisition to startup with exactly-one-source validation before queue/worker/network/workspace creation.

Op-cert signing material is currently read from os.environ in both producer chains (completion and plan-review); thread immutable context-local OpcertSigner binding through _sign_manifest_under_lock and both sign_manifest entrypoints so jobs use injected signer instead of environment patching.

The op-cert application runtime depends on SSM/boto3/region at runtime; materialize the Ed25519 key outside the app via fetch-secrets.sh to a 0600 file and pass its path in REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH, eliminating app-runtime secret-store dependencies.
Process-owned key copy must be stable for process lifetime at 0700 dir/0600 file permissions, survive replacement only on restart, and cleanup must never modify the deployment source.
Concurrent and timed-out workers must not observe or mutate one another's signer/principal/push-policy context; prove context isolation with distinct injected keys while env vars are unset.
